fact: Example: Truthy check on numeric values fails for explicit zero - if (value) is false when value === 0.
recommendation: Use !== undefined or !== null instead of truthy checks when the value could legitimately be 0 or empty string.

fact: @solana/mpp from the npm registry (any published version as of 2026-06-05) contains only TypeScript source files in src/ — no compiled dist/ output. When you `npm install @solana/mpp` and then `import from '@solana/mpp/server'`, Node.js will fail with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND because the package.json exports point to dist/ paths that don't exist.
recommendation: Always use the local monorepo version via a `file:` reference AND run `pnpm build` in the mpp package first. Check package exports in typescript/packages/mpp/package.json to confirm dist/ paths exist before importing.

fact: The solana-clawd GitHub repo only had a `newnew` branch when the curl one-liner was written. The one-liner `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Solizardking/solana-clawd/main/pay.sh | bash` fails with 404 if the `main` branch doesn't exist. GitHub raw URLs must reference a branch that actually exists.
recommendation: Always create and maintain a `main` branch as a public mirror of the development branch. After any push to newnew, also push to main: `git push origin newnew:main`. Verify main exists before publishing the curl one-liner.

fact: The pay-kit demo server lives at /Users/8bit/Downloads/ClawdBrowser/openclawd-framework/pay-kit/demo/clawd-server/ — NOT inside /Users/8bit/Downloads/solana-clawd/. Running `cd demo/clawd-server && pnpm dev` from the solana-clawd directory fails with 'no such file or directory'. The two repos are separate filesystem locations.
recommendation: Always verify the working directory before running demo server commands. The full path is: `/Users/8bit/Downloads/ClawdBrowser/openclawd-framework/pay-kit/demo/clawd-server/`. Use absolute paths in scripts or README instructions to avoid directory confusion.

fact: The harness/src/ directory in pay-kit has a pre-existing TypeScript error involving vitest/globals type definitions. This error exists in the upstream pay-kit repo and is not introduced by Clawd changes. Running `pnpm typecheck` in the harness package will fail unless tsconfig.json includes vitest/globals in types.
recommendation: Do not attempt to fix the vitest/globals TS error in harness/ — it is upstream and will be overwritten on next sync. Run harness tests with `pnpm test` (which uses vitest directly) rather than relying on tsc for type checking in the harness package.

fact: FEE_PAYER_KEY must be a base58-encoded 64-byte keypair (the full secret key), NOT just a public key (32 bytes). If you pass a 32-byte pubkey, `createKeyPairSignerFromBytes` will throw because it cannot derive a signing key from a pubkey alone. The Solana Kit encoder expects the full 64-byte secret.
recommendation: Export the full keypair from Solana CLI: `solana-keygen show --outfile /dev/stdout` returns the base58 secret key. Alternatively use `node -e 'console.log(require("fs").readFileSync("~/.config/solana/id.json")'` to read the JSON array and convert to base58.

fact: pay.sh uses `--full` flag to install the complete Clawd stack including Perplexity AI. But `--full` was initially missing `INSTALL_PERPLEXITY=true` — the flag did not actually install the perplexity package. This caused a silent gap where `--full` users thought they had perplexity support but the binary was missing.
recommendation: Always verify that flag expansion sets ALL expected variables. When adding a new package to the installer, update BOTH the individual `--perplexity` flag handler AND the `--full` flag handler. Test `--full` as a regression check.

fact: The `_env_add` function in pay.sh uses `grep -q "^${1}=" "${ENV_FILE}" 2>/dev/null || printf '\n%s=%s\n' "${1}" "${2}" >> "${ENV_FILE}"` to add env vars idempotently. The `2>/dev/null` is required because grep returns exit 1 when the file doesn't exist yet, which would trigger `set -e` and kill the script.
recommendation: Always add `2>/dev/null` after grep checks on files that may not exist yet. Without it, the first call to `_env_add` when no .env file exists will crash the script under `set -euo pipefail`.

fact: When running `clawd-agents setup`, the command checks PATH for the npm global bin directory. On macOS with nvm, `npm bin -g` may return a path that is NOT on PATH in the current shell session. This means `clawd-agents` installs successfully but is not found by `which clawd-agents`.
recommendation: After `npm install -g @solanaclawd/clawd-agents-cli`, run `npm bin -g` and verify the result is in your PATH. If not, add it: `export PATH=$(npm bin -g):$PATH` in your .zshrc or .bashrc. The pay.sh installer checks this and warns if missing.

fact: The demo app (clawd-app) reads the server base URL from `import.meta.env.VITE_CLAWD_SERVER_URL`. If this env var is not set, it defaults to `http://localhost:4402`. But Vite only loads `.env` files at build time, not at runtime. Changing the env var after `pnpm build` has no effect — you must rebuild.
recommendation: For local dev use `pnpm dev` (which reloads env vars on restart). For production builds, set VITE_CLAWD_SERVER_URL before running `pnpm build`. Never use `pnpm build` for local testing — always use `pnpm dev` to pick up env changes.

fact: OPENROUTER_FREE_MODEL_CLAWD wins over OPENROUTER_FREE_MODEL and OPENROUTER_FREE. Setting OPENROUTER_FREE=openrouter/free has no effect while OPENROUTER_FREE_MODEL_CLAWD or OPENROUTER_FREE_MODEL is still set to a pinned model (e.g. cohere/north-mini-code:free).
recommendation: To switch to the Free Models Router, set OPENROUTER_FREE_MODEL=openrouter/free and clear/unset OPENROUTER_FREE_MODEL_CLAWD. Confirm with GET /status freeModel and freeRouter fields.

fact: clawd_bot/server/routes/chat.ts imports openrouter-attribution from server/lib/. If server/lib/openrouter-attribution.ts is missing, typecheck/runtime fails even though reference/openrouter-attribution.ts exists. Attribution defaults for the portable package prefer CLAWD_BOT_APP_URL/TITLE over OPENROUTER_APP_*.
recommendation: Keep server/lib/openrouter-attribution.ts in the portable package. reference/ is audit-only. Prefer CLAWD_BOT_APP_* for clawdbot.net branding headers.
